name: WP-Spam

roles.name: offer
roles.why: something is on offer: a prize, a sum, a product, a drug, a date

roles.name: ask
roles.why: the reader is told to do something: click, call, reply, send, verify, hurry

roles.name: contact
roles.why: a way to act: a link, an address, a phone number, a shortcode

roles.name: story
roles.why: the advance-fee story: a stranger, a deceased client, a confidential transfer

roles.name: notice
roles.why: a transaction receipt or a subscribed bulletin

roles.name: chat
roles.why: people who know each other: chat forms, quoting, a name in the greeting, a list

roles.name: threat
roles.why: something bad will happen unless the reader acts: a recording, a suspension, a deadline

roles.name: life
roles.why: the writer's own life: what happened, what is planned, family, food, feelings

mlp.name: advanceFee
mlp.why: a stranger, a large sum and a confidential deal together are the advance-fee story

mlp.name: prizeCall
mlp.why: you have won + call/text a number is the premium-rate prize scam

mlp.name: pitch
mlp.why: a sales pitch with a footer and markup is bulk marketing

mlp.name: junkText
mlp.why: more than ~12% consonant fragments: words chopped up with junk between the pieces (texting drops vowels too, but less)

mlp.name: enhancePitch
mlp.why: the euphemistic enhancement pitch: several of its words, usually with a link

mlp.name: salad
mlp.why: text with too few function words is word salad or chopped-up words, not something a person wrote

mlp.name: shortLink
mlp.why: a short message whose point is a link (few words, then a URL) is how bulk spam is written

mlp.name: conversation
mlp.why: quoting, chatting and working together is a conversation between people who know each other

mlp.name: urlVerdict
mlp.why: a lone link is judged by its own shape; inside a message a link must be very bad to count this much (a lone link to a well-known content site is that site; spam quotes such links inside messages, so they vouch only for a lone link)

mlp.name: phishing
mlp.why: your account + pressure + a link is credential phishing (phishers rarely know your name, and a receipt reports rather than demands)

mlp.name: payRequest
mlp.why: asked to send money to a number, and nothing reports a completed transaction (and it is not money the two already agreed on)

mlp.name: cryptoScam
mlp.why: coins plus a payment or a sum: doubling, recovery and investment scams

mlp.name: extortion
mlp.why: "I recorded you" plus payment or a deadline

mlp.name: jobOffer
mlp.why: easy work for good pay

mlp.name: parcelScam
mlp.why: a held parcel and a fee or link

mlp.name: seoPitch
mlp.why: web and mailing-list services sold cold

mlp.name: gambling
mlp.why: casinos and betting

mlp.name: impersonation
mlp.why: a brand talking about your account

mlp.name: techSupport
mlp.why: a renewal or a virus warning with a number to call

mlp.name: debtPitch
mlp.why: loans, credit repair, debt relief

mlp.name: healthPitch
mlp.why: miracle health products

mlp.name: gibberish
mlp.why: more than ~10% of the words cannot be read aloud: fragments and strings made to slip past filters

mlp.name: offerToAct
mlp.why: token-level: an offer or a threat followed by a link or number to act on it

mlp.name: chatter
mlp.why: people who know each other talking about their lives (a stranger, a sum or the advance-fee story switch it off)

mlp.name: prose
mlp.why: 0 only for word salad: few function words AND nearly every token a word. Prose has function words; code, tables and forecasts have few, but are full of numbers and symbols. Short texts count as prose

mlp.name: lifeStory
mlp.why: the writer telling what happened to them, with no sum and no stranger (the advance-fee story has both)

mlp.name: channel
mlp.why: is there any way for the reader to act on this message? (1 = yes)

mlp.name: looseNoChannel
mlp.why: loose words (win, instant, money, you) with no way to act: cancel them. ReLU(loose - 3*channel) is the loose evidence when there is no channel and nothing when there is one; strong evidence (drugs, adult, salad) is not gated

mlp.name: scamArc
mlp.why: the roles appear in the order a pitch is built

mlp.name: spamShape
mlp.why: most sentences of the message offer or ask

mlp.name: hamShape
mlp.why: most sentences of the message chat, work, report or notify

mlp.name: hamInSalad
mlp.why: ham words in text that is not prose: dictionary words poured into spam to look like ordinary mail. The output gives this back the weight the ham words took away, so ham words count only in sentences a person wrote

mlp.name: chatNoChannel
mlp.why: people talking about their lives with nothing to click or call: a conversation, whatever loose words it has

mlp.name: scamInChat
mlp.why: a scam neuron that fires even though the message chats (romance and recovery scams chat first)
